title: Ballot Brief: Your guide to the 2026 midterms
author: Zipporah Osei
bullets: Ballot Brief offers a free newsletter for Massachusetts' 2026 midterms, covering key races and ballot questions.
Early voting in Massachusetts starts August 22, with primaries scheduled for September 1.
Ballot Brief provides updates on debates, statewide ballot questions, and essential election information for voters.

title: Somerville man accused of World Cup ticket scam that netted $14K
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Robert Whelan of Somerville charged with larceny and forgery in $14,000 World Cup ticket scam.
Whelan fabricated emails claiming access to World Cup tickets, leveraging his Patriots season ticket holder status.
Arraigned in Somerville District Court, Whelan's bail set at $250; no contact with victims allowed.

title: Man charged with kidnapping, raping door-to-door salesperson in Everett
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: James Mugford, 67, charged with kidnapping and raping a door-to-door salesperson in Everett, faces multiple charges.
Mugford allegedly threatened the victim with weapons before holding and assaulting her in his home.
He was arraigned in Malden District Court and will remain held without bail, returning to court on Aug. 28.

title: Red Sox reportedly acquire catcher Adley Rutschman from Orioles
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The Red Sox have reportedly acquired All-Star catcher Adley Rutschman from the Baltimore Orioles before the trade deadline.
Boston will send Carlos Narvaez and prospects Anthony Eyanson, Kyson Witherspoon, and Enddy Azocar to Baltimore in the trade.
Rutschman, 28, known for his defensive skills, endured a season with injuries but offers significant improvement over Boston's current catchers.

title: The top four fall foliage destinations in the U.S. are not in New England, according to Priceline
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Priceline's 2026 list ranks Adirondacks, NY as the top U.S. fall foliage destination, followed by Columbia River Gorge.
New England destinations like Bretton Woods, NH, and the Berkshires, MA, placed 5th and 8th in Priceline's fall foliage list.
Vermont's Stowe ranked 9th; New England destinations have previously placed higher in fall foliage rankings.

title: Bruce Springsteen, whose wife was treated in Boston, salutes Pan-Mass Challenge participants
author: Peter Chianca
bullets: Bruce Springsteen praised Pan-Mass Challenge organizers as 'the boss of cancer fundraising' in a video message at a Worcester event.
Springsteen's wife, Patti Scialfa, diagnosed with multiple myeloma, has been treated in Boston; she is currently in remission.
The Pan-Mass Challenge has raised over $1 billion for cancer research at Boston's Dana-Farber Cancer Institute since 1980.

title: 1 dead, 4 injured in overnight Hyde Park shooting
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: One person killed, four injured in a Hyde Park shooting early Monday, police reported.
The shooting occurred around 12:38 a.m. at 1184 Hyde Park Ave; victims were taken to local hospitals.
Boston Police Homicide Unit is investigating; tips can be submitted at 617-343-4470 or 1-800-494-8477 (TIPS).

title: Review & setlist: Zac Brown Band brings ‘Love & Fear’ – and a whole lot of joy – to Fenway
author: Chris Stevens
bullets: Zac Brown Band performed a sold-out show at Fenway Park for their 'Love & Fear Tour' on August 2, 2026.
Surprise guests included Gary Cherone from Extreme and Mac MacAnally, who performed songs by Jimmy Buffett.
Zac Brown announced a $40 million cruise giveaway for all concert attendees during the performance.

title: Vermont Green FC repeats feat with second straight undefeated championship season
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Vermont Green FC completed a second consecutive undefeated season, winning the USL League Two title again.
Vermont defeated Flint City Bucks 2-1 in the final, aided by a penalty kick from Ryan Zellefrow.
Head Coach Chris Taylor remains unbeaten with Vermont Green FC, boasting 35 wins and 7 draws.

title: Review & setlists: Boston favorite Extreme steals Mötley Crüe’s thunder in Mansfield
author: Christopher Hurley
bullets: Extreme performed a powerful 11-song set at Xfinity Center, upstaging headliners Mötley Crüe on August 1, 2026.
Extreme utilized their home advantage, delivering both new hits and classics, including 'More Than Words' and an Ozzy Osbourne medley.
Mötley Crüe closed with a 16-song set featuring 'Shout at the Devil' and 'Kickstart My Heart,' ending with pyrotechnics.
